title: [Bug]: claude 4 model not available in provider list
body:
### Bug Description

Good day, 

Claude 4 has recently been released in the Ireland region in AWS on bed, please can the list of models be updated to support this new model release. 

Please can any inference application endpoints be update to work with claude4 if changes are needed. 

Thanks you, 

Please see code/ list here that needs to be extended to support v4 

https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/96b37a034f5a7e777af1d6575164364cf30577a0/llama-index-integrations/llms/llama-index-llms-anthropic/llama_index/llms/anthropic/utils.py#L33C1-L41C2

### Version

0.12.44

### Steps to Reproduce

Try to use claude 4 EU model with anthroptic llm class
